video.title: AI欧腐《龙王不肯放我走/The Dragon King Won't Let Me Go》
video.desc:
In the Ash Crown Empire, Ethan Cross is the youngest Chief Commander alive — and he has only one rival: to Lucien Draven, the Dragon King.Sent to kill him, Ethan holds a poisoned blade to Lucien's heart and trembles all night. When a regicide plot threatens both their worlds, a sacred bond seals their fates. The whole world wants them to kill each other. They keep getting closer instead.The best enemies make the longest lovers.
在灰冠国，Ethan Cross 是在世最年轻的总指挥官——而他只有一个对手：龙王 Lucien Draven。
奉命刺杀的那一夜，Ethan 把淬毒的刀刃抵在 Lucien 心口，却整整颤抖了一夜。当一场弑君阴谋同时威胁到两个世界，一道神圣的契约将两人的命运锁在了一起。
全世界都想让他们杀死对方。他们却越走越近。
最好的敌人，是最长久的恋人。
